hooks.name: Quality Guard (Spot)
hooks.description: Static site quality for spot sessions

action.prompt: SPOT QUALITY CHECK: 1. No inline styles (use CSS classes) 2. No !important (fix specificity) 3. All images have alt attrs 4. Semantic HTML (not div soup) 5. CSS variables for colors (--color-*) 6. rem for fonts (not px). Violations? List them. Pass? Say nothing.
